system.special: Sneak rolls at an obstacle a Hound guards, or in a Clash with a Hound, are at +1 Difficulty (+1 in all, however many Hounds).
system.notes:
grey, silent, gilt-collared

Long-legged, grey and unnervingly quiet. Hounds never bark; they just look at you. They can smell the Wild on a Bonded kid even in human form.
